title: Herbs for {giver}
summary: {giver}, the healer of {settlement}, is out of herbs. Bring {count} × {item} from the shade of the woods.
offer: Ferns from the shade, six of them, and I can make a start on the coughs.
progress: The ferns? The coughs are getting worse.
complete: Good, green, fresh. These will do a great deal of good.
